decks.name: LeetCode #153 - Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
decks.description: Find the minimum element in a rotated sorted array

cards.question: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array: Suppose an array of length n sorted in ascending order is rotated between 1 and n times. For example, the array nums = [0,1,2,4,5,6,7] might become [4,5,6,7,0,1,2] if it was rotated 4 times, or [0,1,2,4,5,6,7] if it was rotated 7 times. Notice that rotating an array [a[0], a[1], a[2], ..., a[n-1]] 1 time results in the array [a[n-1], a[0], a[1], a[2], ..., a[n-2]]. Given the sorted rotated array nums of unique elements, return the minimum element of this array. You must write an algorithm that runs in O(log n) time.

solutions.name: Binary Search (Lower Bound)
solutions.explanation: Use binary search to find the rotation pivot where the minimum element is located. Compare middle element with right boundary to determine which half contains the minimum. Most elegant solution with clean logic.

semanticLines: Define function findMin that accepts array nums
Initialize l to zero and r to length of nums minus one
Start while loop that continues while l is less than r
Calculate midpoint m by adding l to the result of r minus l divided by two using integer division
Check if element at index m is less than element at index r
If less, minimum is in left half including m, so set r to m
Otherwise minimum is in right half
Set l to m plus one
After loop ends, return element at index l as the minimum

solutions.name: Binary Search
solutions.explanation: Binary search that tracks the current minimum while navigating the rotated array. Check if current portion is sorted, if so take minimum and break early. Otherwise update pointers based on which half is sorted.
